tasks.title: Unified real-system runner
tasks.body:
1. **T1 — Unified real-system runner.** `node .codex/scripts/verify-all.mjs`: one command, real exit codes, per-suite summary. Runs: epi-lib `make test` (C); portal-core `cargo test`; epi-cli `cargo test`; schemas `pnpm test` (epi-cli/schemas); pratibimba-app `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build`; then the live-wire stage (T2). Fails loud on any suite; prints a table (suite · tests · result · seconds). No suite may be skipped silently — a skipped suite is a FAIL unless `--only` was explicitly passed.
   Verify: run it on the current basis; record the full table; deliberately break one kernel test and one app test and show both failures propagate to exit≠0.

tasks.title: Live-wire projection harness
tasks.body:
2. **T2 — Live-wire projection harness.** Generalize the phase-1 boot-smoke/kairos-wire-check pattern into `scripts/live-wire.mjs` (pratibimba-app): spawn a REAL `epi gate start` on an ephemeral port, capture N `profile.update` frames + named event channels (`m123.chime`, …), strict-parse every frame against the Zod contracts, assert a declared projection manifest (field present · shape · exemplar invariant, e.g. `liveOctet[i].hz === audioOctet[i]`, `sum(suit pp)==360` when the projection lands), dump the captured fixture to `plan.runs/wire-captures/`. Every rerun tranche that lands a profile field or gateway method MUST register its assertion here — the manifest is the growing proof of the bus.
   Verify: run against the current basis — phaseSpace/modalResonator/quintessence/planetDegrees/livePlanets all captured, parsed, invariants asserted; corrupt one frame in a replay-mode test and show the harness rejects it.

tasks.title: Anti-fraud test lint
tasks.body:
3. **T3 — Anti-fraud test lint.** `node .codex/scripts/lint-test-honesty.mjs` over all test files in pratibimba-app + any rerun-added tests: REJECT tests whose only assertions are source-string greps, file-existence, manifest/JSON-literal text matching, or test-count assertions; REJECT `--mark done` evidence strings containing the banned classes ("design only", "deferred", "direct close", file-existence). Explicit allowlist file for the few genuinely-structural checks (e.g. coordinate-header presence), each with a justification line. Wire into verify-all.
   Verify: the lint passes on the current app suite; add a fixture test that greps a source string as its only assertion and show the lint fails it; show a banned evidence string is refused.

tasks.title: Kernel truth suite (the red tests)
tasks.body:
4. **T4 — Kernel truth suite (the red tests).** Automate the recapture register §4.7/§5 spot-audits as real tests that FAIL while the violation stands: (a) `m3_compute_charges` reachable via FFI from Rust with boot asserts `sum(pp)==360` + 64-codon cross-check against a Rust caller (fails while oracle.rs reimplements charges — register §5.1); (b) element-ID canonical-B converters round-trip (37.10); (c) DR-R0 route words (`0x5FC1` family) pinned; (d) transcription constants 27 SHARED + 37 TRANSCRIBABLE + 1 START + 3 STOP boot check; (e) `m1_ananda_get` fidelity vs the canonical 12×12 Vortex Modulae CSV (fails while the 10×10 %10 core stands — 10.10); (f) `kernel_energy_evaluate` carries E₄/E₅/E₆ with 4:5:6 weighting (fails while the plain-sum stands — Track 33); (g) **Spanda dual-oscillator primitive** — `spanda_hkb_antiphase_bistability` (the relative-phase field converges to the two attractors φ=0 in-phase / φ=π antiphase from perturbed init), `spanda_standing_identity_superposition` (the counter-phase superposition at the node computes `0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1`), `tick12_flowers_from_oscillation` (the twelvefold is generated by spanda's flowering internal to the oscillation and QL derives FROM it — not an independent 12-LUT, not QL-positions-first), `codon_advances_on_rotational_state_not_tick12` (the active codon steps from the quaternionic-rotational + epogdoon state, not the bare `tick12` integer), `spanda_bistability_threshold_asymmetry` (φ=π stable only above b/a = 1/4 and collapses below it with hysteresis, while φ=0 stays stable at every value — the `=/≠` landscape asymmetry; added 2026-07-06), and `spanda_two_involutions_distinct` (reflection `11−n` ≠ half-turn `n+6`, Klein four-group closure with `5−n`; the pole-swap invariant on solo-pole observables, detectable only in superposition; added 2026-07-06) all fail while the tick is asserted as a bare 12-index ring with no oscillatory substrate (Track 02 T2.11 — see its `=/≠` dynamics and two-involutions blocks for the decided readings). Red is the deliverable: each failure is the work order for its owning rerun track.
   Verify: suite runs under verify-all with an expected-failures manifest; each red test names its owning track; any unexpectedly-green entry is investigated and re-recorded.

tasks.title: Verifier protocol runner
tasks.body:
6. **T6 — Verifier protocol runner.** `node .codex/scripts/verify-tranche.mjs <TASK_ID>`: reads the tranche's Verify lines (original file + rerun stub), re-executes the named commands fresh, records verbatim output to `plan.runs/verifications/<task-id>.md`, and refuses to record a pass if verify-all is red or the honesty lint fails. This is the independent-verifier half of verifier ≠ closer made mechanical; the human/agent verifier reads the recorded output, not the implementer's claim.
   Verify: run it against two already-verified phase-1 tasks (their checks re-execute green); run against a tranche with a failing check and show the refusal.

tasks.title: Spanda dual-oscillator primitive (the tick floor)
tasks.body:
11. **T2.11 — Spanda dual-oscillator primitive (the tick floor)** *(2026-07-06: the six acceptance reds are AUTHORED and manifested in portal-core `tests/kernel_truth.rs` + `kernel-truth-expected-failures.json` — red stands as this tranche's work order; see [[00-computational-core-truth-ledger]])* *(NEW 2026-07-04 — decided design, ratified in-session; substrate build, execute as written per CHARTER "Resolved by plan authority")*

   **Why this exists.** The recapture register and the 2026-06-02 recon treated the tick as substrate already landed (`RING_QUATERNION_LUT[12]`, `DOUBLE_COVER_DEG=720`, `engine_double_covering`). A 2026-07-04 substrate read found it rooted **one layer too high**: the (0/1)/(1/0) dual oscillation exists in `m1.h:147–210` and `spanda.rs` **only as static algebra** — `SPANDA_POLE_A=(0/1)`, `SPANDA_POLE_B=(1/0)`, `SPANDA_SEED_BITS=0x03` (both fused), `spanda_invert(n)=11−n` (the `#` as a discrete index-complement) — with **no oscillator**: no continuous phase, no counter-phase superposition, no standing wave, no beat. The 12-tick ring is a bare integer LUT and the 720° cover is *asserted* (`engine_double_covering` = walk-twice-with-a-flip, `engine.c:71`), never *derived*. This tranche lands the missing dynamical floor. It is foundational — T2.5 (`#` operator), T2.6 (K² played-torus), and T2.9 (Ananda) sit **on** it.

   **Rooting (decided).** Per `Idea/Bimba/Map/M1/`: M1-0 = Bimba (0/1), M1-1 = Pratibimba (1/0), M1-3 = Trika synthesis `((0/1)/(1/0)) = (0/1/2)` — matching the substrate enum `SPANDA_SEED → POLE_A → POLE_B → TRIKA` (m1.h:162–166) and `TRIKA_GROUND = fused (0/1)/(1/0)` (m1.h:175). Ananda's six DR matrices are a **separate** structure off the same seed, not the rooting locus.

   **The primitive.** A continuous dual oscillator governed by the **Haken–Kelso–Bunz relative-phase equation** — the canonical two-oscillators-in-opposite-phase model:
   - `φ̇ = Δω − a·sin φ − 2b·sin 2φ`, potential `V(φ) = −a·cos φ − b·cos 2φ`.
   - Bistable at φ=0 (in-phase = `SPANDA_SEED`, the fused poles) and φ=π (antiphase = the poles opposed) — the two attractors ARE bimba/pratibimba fusion vs opposition; the Trika is their relation.
   - First+second-harmonic coupling (`sin φ + sin 2φ`) = fundamental **plus octave** — the direct hook into the 16/9 musical derivation, so the harmonic frame is in the base dynamics, not bolted on.
   - The standing identity `0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1` (spanda file-four) is the superposition **node** the field computes — the thing the current code never evaluates.

   **The `=/≠` dynamics (NEW 2026-07-06 — decided reading, ratified in-session; extends the primitive, changes no prior decision).** The Reflective Distinction `0 =/≠ 1` (M1-0/M1-1 canon; `Idea/Bimba/Map/M1/M1-1.md` q-registers) is not a logical annotation on the seed — it IS the double-well potential, read directly:
   - **The in-phase basin (φ=0) is the `=`** — poles fused, `SPANDA_SEED`, identity. **The antiphase basin (φ=π) is the `≠`** — poles maximally opposed, the Reflective Distinction at full stretch. **The slash in `0/1` is the potential barrier (the `b·cos 2φ` term) between the wells.** The `=/≠` thereby becomes a measurable order parameter — relative phase — not an asserted equation.
   - **The landscape is asymmetric, and the asymmetry IS the non-dual content.** In HKB (Δω=0 form), φ=0 is stable for ALL positive coupling values (`V″(0) = a + 4b > 0` always); φ=π is stable ONLY above the critical coupling ratio (`V″(π) = 4b − a > 0` ⇔ **b/a > 1/4** — below it the antiphase well vanishes and the system falls into in-phase; this collapse is the canonical HKB phase transition the model was built on). Dynamically stated: **identity is unconditional; difference is real but conditional — a held achievement, not a given.** Neither monism (only φ=0 exists) nor dualism (two symmetric eternal wells) can produce this shape; the asymmetry is the testable rendering of non-duality. Spanda gets its mechanism here: near the threshold, critical fluctuation and phase slips — the "trembling slash" is the system flickering at the edge of the antiphase well.
   - **The standing wave renders `=/≠` spatially and sensorily.** The standing identity `0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1` is constructive interference at the **antinode** (amplitude 2×, the 100%); the SAME two waves meeting in antiphase cancel at the **node** (amplitude 0). Antinodes are the `=` heard as loudness; nodes are the `≠` heard as silence. Downstream (M2' cymatic rendering, not this build): Chladni figures form along node LINES — the visible pattern is the zero-set of the vibration, the `≠` made visible; the figure one sees (pratibimba) is precisely where the sound is not (bimba withdrawn). The M2' standing-wave rendering already planned (4 nodal parameters as boundary conditions) inherits this law; it is recorded here so the audio-engine layer knows what it is testing.
   - **The `≠` is only audible relationally (signal-theoretic fact, load-bearing for the post-binary claim).** A polarity inversion (phase-flip) of a single wave is inaudible in isolation — it manifests ONLY in co-presence with the original, as cancellation. Pratibimba is indistinguishable from Bimba except in relation. Binary logic has no equivalent: a flipped bit is detectable alone; a flipped phase is not. This is where "non-dual post-binary" becomes empirically demonstrable in the audio engine rather than merely encoded.

   **Two distinct involutions (NEW 2026-07-06 — decided; closes a latent ambiguity in `#`).** The 12-ring carries TWO different order-2 operations, and the current code holds only one. `spanda_invert(n) = 11−n` is a **reflection** — the traversal-reversal, the `1/0` return-switch (same terms, reading direction reversed). **Antiphase is a half-turn, `n ↦ n+6 (mod 12)`** — the pole-swap. They are NOT the same operation; their composition yields the third involution `n ↦ 5−n (mod 12)`, and `{identity, half-turn (n+6), reflection (11−n), composite (5−n)}` close as a Klein four-group inside the ring's dihedral symmetry. They carry distinct sensory signatures: time-reversal is audible alone; polarity-swap is audible only in superposition. Consequences: (a) the `#` operator vocabulary (T2.5 carrier, DR-M1-3, the VAK layer) must type WHICH involution a given `#` application means — `#`-as-reflection (traversal-reversal) vs `#`-as-half-turn (pole-swap); (b) `spanda_invert(n)=11−n` remains the reflection and is NOT redefined — the half-turn enters as its own named operation on the field; (c) VAK transition typing inherits three phase classes from the one equation: identity-preserving (in-phase), inverting (antiphase), creative/slipping (the Δω beat).

   **Cross-system grounding (what actually propagates).** Consistent with the honesty fences: what crosses M1/M2/M3 is the **φ-form** — the in-phase/antiphase/slipping structure — as typed structure riding the shared clock index, never as physical frequency or energy. Each system instantiates the same relational form at its own carrier scale. Downstream polarities are thereby typed as φ-readings rather than introduced as fresh ontological pairs: yin/yang, Mono/Poly, Day/Night', P/P' are "which basin, or in transit." The M3 nucleotide construction already IS the pole pair — `R# = 0/1` and `## = 1/0` (m3.h) are Pole A and Pole B — so a hexagram line is a frozen φ-sample and the codon system is downstream of the same distinction, exactly as the rooting decides.

   **The twelvefold is intrinsic, prior to QL (the load-bearing correction).** The spanda movement toward `1/1 = 100%` carries a **twelve-foldness within the oscillation itself**, generated by spanda's full set of flowerings (M1-3; `SPANDA_FLOWERING`, the 6 CF sub-stages whose fold-counts climb 4 → 6 → 8 → … → 12, m1.h:203–210). This twelvefold is **prior to and generative of** the QL system (M1-4) — it is NOT a ring sampled from above, NOT QL's 12 positions × 2 phases. The current code inverts the causality (`RING_SIZE 12 /* 6 × 2 */` reads QL-first); the primitive restores the true order: **oscillation → its intrinsic twelvefold flowering → QL**. The 12-tick ring is the manifestation of that internal flowering, not its source. `spanda_invert(n)=11−n` remains the `#` acting on it.

   **Residency (decided — CHARTER "Resolved by plan authority").** The oscillation reality is authored in **`epi-lib` C** (`m1.c`/`m1.h`, the `.rodata` Siva ground where the poles + seed already live): the HKB φ-field, the flowering, the intrinsic twelvefold. It **propagates into `portal-core/spanda.rs`** as the mirrored surface — exactly as the system does everywhere (C ground → Rust surface). Rust reflects the dynamics; it does not own them. Substrate work, no interface waiting on anyone.

   **Frequency anchor.** Base frequency anchored to the conserved-delta centre **≈2.5 Hz**, reported as a cited band — never a fake-precise 2.0 Hz. Sources: Buzsáki, Logothetis & Singer 2013 + Mizuseki 2014 (oscillation-frequency hierarchy preserved across a 17,000-fold brain-volume range, non-allometric); PLOS Biology 2026 (98-species acoustic rhythm converges on 2.7 Hz, non-allometric). Clean 2.0 Hz is human-only spontaneous motor tempo — cite as such if used. Frequency + HKB coefficients are config-driven (`[ml.m1_paramasiva]`), no hardcoded constants. **Three rates must not be conflated** (scoping-memo finding): the ~2.5 Hz oscillation beat is NOT the 1 Hz `profile.update` heartbeat, and NOT the 12 Hz at `physical-pole-stack-architecture.md:37` — which is a UI **display framerate** mislabeled "the kernel's natural breath-rate"; correcting that mislabel is part of this build. The deeper biological/physics grounding (M3 physics + codon, cross-M') is scoped in `plan.runs/t2.11-tick-biology-physics-scoping.md` — it informs the anchor, it does not gate this build.

   **Honesty guardrail (load-bearing).** HKB's 0/π bistability *resonates with* the double-cover but is **not** a literal spinor; the biological SU(2)/720° reading is speculative. The tick's counter-phase beat roots in **HKB + delta** (real, cited); the **720° double-cover stays the M1-5 quaternionic layer above it** (`hopf.rs`, `quaternion.rs`), derived on its own SU(2) terms. Do not let biology stand in as proof of topology, and do not let the ~2.5 Hz beat masquerade as a physical frequency across M2/M3 (the scales do not couple) — those separations are the difference between grounding and numerology.

   **Three-spanda-equation propagation (all three).** At `Body/S/S5/plugins/epi-logos/resources/updated-ql-mef/non-dual-binary/canonical-candidate/`: (1) **Genesis** `0=(0/0)→((0/1)/(1/0))→[T₀]→[T₁]→(1/0+0/1)→1/1` = the birth and one full beat, and where the intrinsic twelvefold flowering lives; (2) **Base Frame** `100%=64+36→16/9→4+2` = the beat's structure — the 16/9 octave-minus-wholetone IS the second-harmonic coupling term, the 4+2 the QL frame the flowering generates; (3) **M-Stack** `137=64+72+1` = the tick stratifying as a **shared discrete clock index** across M1(+1)/M2(72)/M3(64) — NOT a physical frequency spanning them. The honest M1↔M3 link (scoping memo) is exactly this: the codon is a 6-bit combinatorial clock address (`m3.h:65-89`, `kernel.rs:407-409`) that shares the tick index, it does not resonate with it — the delta beat (~2.5 Hz), M2's audio Hz (Cousto 126–221, `m2.h:320-331`), and M3's terahertz codon chemistry are ~12 orders apart with no coupling mechanism. The tick aligns these as a common clock, never as a physical frequency.

   Cross-links: T2.5 (`#` Inversion_Operator carrier), DR-M1-3 (`#` carrier as bus field), Track-00 T4(e) Ananda 12×12 (shares the seed — reconcile together, do not regress Ananda). Canon write-back as-we-go per [[SEED-HARMONISATION-PROTOCOL]]: [[M1'-SPEC]] §14 (`(0/1)`-wiring) and `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/M/M1'/M1-ARCHITECTURE.md` (not a gate — a follow-through).

   - **`=/≠` reading (2026-07-06)** — in-phase basin = `=`, antiphase basin = `≠`, the slash = the potential barrier; the landscape asymmetry (φ=0 unconditionally stable, φ=π conditional on b/a > 1/4) is load-bearing canon — tested, never symmetrized away, never flattened into "two equal poles."

   Brief: [[M1-3-SPANDA-TRANSPORT-ARCHITECTURE]] §2 (ownership law) + §8 tranche 1. The spanda cycle phase becomes **kernel-owned state** in `Body/S/S0/portal-core`: a `SpandaPhaseAnchor { epoch_ms, phase0, rate_hz, mode: Flowing|Held|Walking, direction: Forward|Reflected }` with **lazy evaluation** — `phase_at(now_ms)` computed on read (flowing → `phase0 + 2π·rate·Δt`; held → `phase0` constant), **no loop at any frequency, at any grain**. `tick12`/`degree720` in the heartbeat projection derive from the anchor via `spanda::tick12_readout` — the gateway heartbeat (`Body/S/S0/epi-cli/src/gate/server/mod.rs` `spawn_profile_heartbeat`) becomes a **sampler of the anchor**, retiring the wall-clock tick derivation in `from_clock_tick` that contradicted T2.11 canon ("nothing re-grounds on the bare tick"). Wall-clock stays for timestamps and the kairos sky (world-owned, never held). `rate_hz` from `[ml.m1_paramasiva]` config, band-checked ~1.5–4.0 Hz per T2.11 — never a hardcoded fake.

   **Decisions locked (do not re-decide):** engine owns the phase — never gateway-loop state, never renderer state; the portal keeps its 1 Hz cadence and liveness job (derived-from, never 1:1 — Architect ruling, DR-M1-5); `generation` stays a portal-owned monotonic emission counter and **advances while held** (same phase content, new generations — the carrier's monotonic gate is untouched); the audio-engine migration path is an implementor swap behind the same anchor contract (define the contract accordingly); display-scrub vs engine-walk naming law per the architecture doc §0 — this tranche builds neither transport, only the anchor both stand on.


   Verify: `cargo test -p portal-core --offline` (kernel-truth extension: held anchor ⇒ constant `tick12` readout across evaluations at different `now_ms`; flowing anchor ⇒ readout advances; same anchor + same instant ⇒ identical derived profile content — determinism pinned); `bash -c "cd Body/M/pratibimba-app && node scripts/boot-smoke.mjs"` (the organism boots against the anchor-fed heartbeat: live profile tick arrives and advances).

tasks.body:
5. **T9.5 — One-substrate / three-rendering integration plugin ownership**

   Brief: `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/M/Legacy/plans/2026-06-02-m-prime-cycle-3-design-reconciliation/09-integrated-bimba-graph-reconciliation.md` — Tranche 9.5 in full (that section IS the spec; owning Mn'/Sn specs are law above it). Retarget per `CHARTER.md` (substrate work unchanged; Theia surfaces → carrier panes/engine carriers; epi-theia frozen).
   Original ledger status: quarantine — verify or rebuild; never build on it unverified.
   Verify: `cargo test --manifest-path Body/S/S0/epi-cli/Cargo.toml --test gate_temporal_context --test kernel_bridge_runtime_contract`; `cargo test --manifest-path Body/S/S0/epi-cli/Cargo.toml --test gate_temporal_context live_redis_temporal_context_hydration_uses_s3_namespace -- --ignored --exact`; `pnpm --dir Body/S/S0/epi-cli/schemas test`; `pnpm --dir Body/M/pratibimba-app exec vitest run src/bridge/gatewayClient.test.ts src/state/useProfileTick.test.tsx src/composition/compositionContract.test.ts scripts/live-wire.test.mjs`; `node Body/M/pratibimba-app/scripts/live-wire.mjs --profiles 8 --no-dump`. Verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

   **Ratified seam (Architect, 2026-07-16 — recorded in plan, no DR):**
   - The three renderings are the **M1/M2/M3 body poles** at their `-5` positions — M1 torus-knot/Klein `+1`, M2 72-cymatic, M3 64-codon — composing `137 = 64 + 72 + 1` (the track-07 arrangement already landed in `compositionMatheme.ts`). This is the canonical M2/M3 seam; the older wave-b "M0′ graph + M2′ solar + M3′ clock" phrasing is superseded.
   - **M0′ is the graph VIEW of the Bimba map** (its six data-layers: lang/ql/rel/time/pers/pedag) — the structural affordance over the SAME substrate, NOT a fourth pole. It re-reads the substrate like the body poles do.
   - **B-8 non-fork:** one Neo4j `:Bimba` graph under every rendering. **B-11/B-12 write path is governed-route** (DR-M0-1), never raw M0′ CRUD.

   **Landed + tested (this tranche) — B-12 wire, all 4 edges:**
   1. **Composition contract** — `Body/M/pratibimba-app/src/composition/compositionContract.ts` (+ test, 8 cases): declares `plugin-integrated-1-2-3` owns **B-8/B-9/B-12**, encodes the seam above, states the B-12 propagation law grounded in the single monotonic generation gate (no per-surface stale cache).
   2. **Kernel-bridge relay** — `graph_revision: Option<u64>` on `KernelBridgeCachedProfile` + `KernelBridgeProfileJsonShape`, read verbatim from the projection context (`safe_cached_profile_from_context`), serialized additively (`graphRevision`, skip-when-None). Test `kernel_bridge_relays_graph_revision_from_context_for_b12_propagation` (contract suite green, 26 pass).
   3. **Carrier consumption** — `graphRevision` on `bridge/types.ts KernelBridgeCachedProfile` + surfaced on the one re-render seam `useProfileTick().graphRevision`; `crossSurfacePropagation` fires on live data (useProfileTick suite green, 11 pass).

   4. **S3 gateway stamp** — `gate/temporal.rs` reads canonical [[S2]] `GraphMeta.graph_revision` with a bounded live Neo4j query and stamps hydrated `context["kernel"]["graphRevision"]`; `gate/server/mod.rs` reuses a reconnecting background metadata client and samples it into `profile.update` without putting graph latency on the 1 Hz heartbeat. The carrier lifts only non-negative safe integers. Real proof: the Docker-backed temporal test compares the stamped value with live `GraphMeta`; live-wire captured 8/8 profile frames with a non-negative, non-regressing revision and passed the complete projection manifest. B-12 is live end-to-end.

   (a) **carried.** "Monaco upgrade" was a Theia-stack instruction; the carrier's editor was already a real one — `MarkdownEditorPane` runs CodeMirror 6 with markdown mode, an editable gate, and a debounced S1-scoped save. Porting Monaco would have been the deprecated widget-port, not the function. The two Monaco APIs the spec actually names land as their CodeMirror equivalents: `IModelDeltaDecoration` → `Decoration.mark`, `CompletionItemProvider` → `CompletionSource` (`src/panes/canonEditorExtensions.ts`).

Coordinate validity stays `ui/tokens.ts::coordinateFamilyGrade` — the scanner decides token boundaries only; wikilinks win over nested coordinates so `RangeSetBuilder` never sees an overlap. `frontmatter-key` is NOT a third inline kind: this carrier splits frontmatter out of the writing surface, so key law is disclosed in the fold instead.
   (c) **face-gap → built, against the live method.** The spec's `s1'.semantic.suggest` never landed and is `unimplemented` in the live probe; the note-scoped `s1'.semantic.suggest_links` IS live (28.T28.12 rides the same one). `[[` completion asks it for this note's neighbours, gates every candidate through `isPrivacySafe`, orders by S1's score, and discloses index staleness. Disconnected gateway and S1 error both refuse honestly — no suggestions, no throw.
   (d) **partly carried, partly bounded.** The C-family typology authority per DR-S1-5 is `s1'.type.classify_c_layer` (live, VALIDATED); the frontmatter fold reads its receipt and renders nothing it derived itself. `C_FAMILY_SCHEMA` in `@pratibimba/m-extension-runtime` — the module the spec names — never existed even in the frozen tree. Frontmatter **key-shape** law is S1's `hen-compiler-core::validate_frontmatter`, reachable only as the CLI `epi vault frontmatter-validate`; it has **no gateway seam**, and adding one is a public-surface change that belongs to the Architect, so the fold DISCLOSES the gap rather than duplicating S1 law in the carrier. PASU: the identity note routes to the LIVE PASU wizard (`identity.openWizard`, 25.T25.4, writes via `nara.pasu.set`) instead of growing a second identity editor.

The spec's two named colours land as real tokens (`--mediator-pi` purple, `--mediator-anima` gold, both polarities); the six Aletheia guardians are DERIVED from the Aletheia family token by `color-mix` rather than minting a seventh raw hue — a per-subagent palette is a 30-design-language decision, not a pane's.

The collapse is also how one component serves both DR-WC-IS-2 foldings.
   (d) **carried.** The tool-stream cross-link already carried `data-cross-link="omnipanel.tool-stream"` + `data-evidence-id` and activates the fold with the same record; the 27.9 table registers both directions.
   (e) **bounded, disclosed.** The spec's `CrossLayoutIntent` at `ide-shell-m0-m5/axiom-translation-inspector` HAS NO TARGET: `piAxiomTranslation` is mounted (§2, cosmic deep model) but no row of `CROSS_LAYOUT_INTENT_TARGETS` resolves to it and `intentTarget` answers null — the identical gap 28.T28.7 recorded from the Atelier side. Minting a target id is a public-surface change (Architect / 28.T28.14), so the deep fold renders the affordance DISABLED with the target and reason on screen. Compounding it: nothing emits DR-B-2 steps, so `axiomTranslationSteps` is empty for every real packet.

The inbound sibling route `m5-epii/contemplation-object-viewer.open` already lands on the Evidence fold, so the pair is bidirectional under the carrier's own names. Recorded in the seam register, not silently substituted.
   **DR-WC-IS-2 → built.** The frozen tree had two evidence widgets; this carrier has one fold plus the deep governance pane, so the two foldings are ONE component with a declared `fold` prop — `abbreviated` in `omniEvidence`, `deep` in a new `acr-evidence-audit` section of `agenticControlRoom` (`ide-deep` only) over the same producer and deposits. Both read and write `perTabState.evidence.selectedPacketId`, which is the bidirectional record identity; there is NO `ide-deep` intent promotion, because `DEPTH_DIFFERENTIATED_COMPONENTS` does not license `agenticControlRoom` (52.T3) — that click-through is disabled and names the missing target.

9. **T28.9 — Review pane: IOD-17 three-way parity matrix + dispatch-genealogy click-through + DR-WC-IS-2 deep-vs-abbreviated split**

   Brief: `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/M/Legacy/plans/2026-06-02-m-prime-cycle-3-design-reconciliation/28-ide-shell-chrome-deep.md` — Tranche 28.9 in full (that section IS the spec; owning Mn'/Sn specs are law above it).    Original ledger status: audit_required — verify or rebuild; never build on it unverified.
   Landed (rerun, 2026-07-30) — the five deliverables, sorted by DR-FACE-7 fate:
   (a) **spine-gap → built.** There was NO review-item type in the carrier at all — neither `ReviewItemDeep` nor a base `ReviewItem`. The `/` Review fold projected genealogy records into generic Track-44 `Block`s carrying `{runId, actor, method, capability, status, startedAtMs, endedAtMs}`, and the deep ACR queue carried the raw `AcrReviewItem` off `s5'.review.inbox`. `panes/omni/review/reviewItemDeep.ts` is the type and the ONE producer both foldings call. The base is ALIASED to `acrReviewInbox.ts::AcrReviewItem` (28.T28.5's strict wire projection), never re-declared. Two fields are NULLABLE against the spec's literal declaration, because the alternative is fabrication: `iod17Parity` is absent until the capability matrix answers (an all-`unset` readout still computes `inParity: false`, i.e. the red banner, from a measurement nobody took), and `dispatchGenealogyRef` is absent when the surface holds no genealogy (`ReviewInboxItem` carries no genealogy field on the wire — `Body/S/S5/epii-review-core/src/lib.rs`). The other two fields are JOINS over real reads: the packet id is the review item's own id exactly when an anchored `s5'.epii.deposit` backs it (the packet producer composes with `id = deposit.itemId` only when `evidenceAnchors` are present), and the genealogy ref is the session's root dispatch node by the packet producer's own matching rule — the sibling suite asserts the two agree on real data, so the review row and the evidence packet can never name different runs.
   (b) **face-gap → built.** The three-cell matrix marks a cell green only on `human-required`, red on `agent-allowed` AND on `unset` (an unread face is not an agreeing one), carries the aggregate `inParity` line, and raises the spec's verbatim banner as `role="alert"`. The violation string is imported from `acrGovernance.ts` (DR-WC-IS-1's source of truth), never restated.
   (c) **built, with the landing named.** "View dispatch tree →" rides the LIVE 27.9 route `ide-shell-m0-m5/agentic-control-room.select-run`, carrying the genealogy ref as `artifactUri` into the Dispatch fold with the same node identity (15.11). Inside the deep pane the same click needs no hop and selects that pane's own RunTree. What it CANNOT do is open the deep pane from the `/` fold: the `agentic-control-room` target resolves to `omniDispatchTrace` and `DEPTH_DIFFERENTIATED_COMPONENTS` does not license `agenticControlRoom` (52.T3 / 28.T28.14) — the identical gap 28.T28.8 recorded from the evidence side — so the crossing renders DISABLED and names the target.
   (d) **built.** "View evidence →" rides the LIVE route `ide-shell-m0-m5/evidence-pane.select-packet` on `perTabState.evidence.selectedPacketId`, the ONE key both evidence foldings read (28.T28.8), so one click lands the record in the abbreviated fold and the deep audit at once. The reverse route `omnipanel-shell/evidence.open-review` was already live, so the pair is bidirectional.
   (e) **built.** The human-required banner now carries a parity status LINE whose content differs by folding, and the ACR decision control's gate refusal carries one too — the refusal says why THIS operator cannot commit, the line says whether the substrate would accept the transition at all. Two different failures a single sentence used to blur. No modal anywhere (15.2).
   **DR-WC-IS-2 → built, and a real gap closed.** Until this tranche NO carrier surface but the deep ACR read `s5'.review.inbox`. `ReviewBlocksPane` now reads it LIVE (plus `s5'.epii.deposit.list` for the packet identity) and renders the same rows through the same `ReviewItemDeepView` at `fold="abbreviated"`; the deep half is the ACR's `acr-review-queue` at `fold="deep"`. ONE row identity — `perTabState.review.selectedReviewId` — so a row chosen in either surface is the row the other renders. The Track-44 BLOCK rows below the queue are UNCHANGED and still ride the synthetic fixture until track-12's wire→record producer lands; the fold's banner now labels the two sources separately instead of speaking for both.
   Ratcheted as present for this tranche: `s5'.review.inbox`, `s5'.review.resolve`, `s5'.review.submit`, `s5'.epii.deposit.list`, `s4'.mediation.capabilities.list` (probed in `Body/S` by the sibling suite). Declared ABSENT and machine-guarded: `s5'.review.transition`, and any `ide-deep`-promoting `agentic-control-room` target.

tasks.body:
5. **T30.5 — Accessibility contracts**

   Brief: `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/M/Legacy/plans/2026-06-02-m-prime-cycle-3-design-reconciliation/30-design-language-layer.md` — Tranche 30.5 in full (that section IS the spec; owning Mn'/Sn specs are law above it). Retarget per `CHARTER.md` (substrate work unchanged; Theia surfaces → carrier panes/engine carriers; epi-theia frozen).
   Original ledger status: quarantine — verify or rebuild; never build on it unverified. REBUILT from the spec against the live carrier; nothing was inherited from the quarantined claim.
   Landed (rerun, 2026-07-27) — the contract as EXECUTABLE law, not prose. Carrier retarget of the frozen `extensions/contracts/ui-accessibility.{ts,md}`: `Body/M/pratibimba-app/src/ui/accessibility.ts` (executable half) + `ACCESSIBILITY-CONTRACT.md` (prose half), 28 tests in `src/ui/accessibility.test.ts`.
   - **Focus ring**: `FOCUS_RING_MIN_PX` = 2. Named gap, disclosed not restyled: `.face-toggle-button` / `.m0-coordinate-summary-card-open` / `.m4-nara-floating-menu button` express focus as a 1px `border-color` swap with `outline: none` — a real indicator but below the minimum. Those surfaces belong to 15.10 / 21.T21.17 / 25.x; a focus sweep is their owners' visual change to make.
   - **Reduced motion (DR-WC-DL-4)**: `MOTION_KIND` classifies each channel continuous vs discrete and `reducedMotionDurationMs()` resolves it — continuous stops (0ms), discrete is PRESERVED as a `REDUCED_MOTION_SNAP_MS` (100ms) snap because removing it would remove the state-change semantics; layout switch is the one canon makes instantaneous.
   - **Screen reader**: `coordinateAriaLabel` speaks coordinate + family tier + archetype (`M4-3` → "M4 dash 3, subsystem family, nara") reusing `ui/coordinateNames.ts` as the naming authority, now wired into the `CoordinateString` primitive; `cl42SignatureAriaLabel`; `createTickAnnouncer` rate-limits the `aria-live` region to one announcement per second (the heartbeat pulses at 1Hz). `CodonString` already met the contract — it reads the real gateway codon lookup.
   - **BOUNDED, not invented** (same discipline as 28.T28.4's frontmatter key-shape law): `HexagramString`'s name component needs I-Ching hexagram NAMES = M3 kernel law, and `SymbolicCoordinateString`'s decomposition needs the verifier-authored M0/Anuttara grammar. Neither has a carrier-reachable surface, and a 64-entry name table in `src/ui/` would put kernel law in M'. Each primitive announces what it can verify instead of a name it guessed; the fix shape is a read method, which `CodonString` already demonstrates.
   - **Contrast**: `WCAG_AA` (4.5 body / 3 large / 3 UI) + a real sRGB `contrastRatio()` proven against WCAG's published extremes (black-on-white = 21:1) and asserted green over BOTH shipped themes' ink/ground pairs. An unparseable colour (a `var(--…)` reference) returns null and `meetsContrast` fails it — a pair that cannot be asserted must never read as one that passed. The lint enumerating every declared pair stays 30.11's (`lint-carrier-tokens`); this contract supplies the threshold and the ratio function.
   - **Keybindings**: `A11Y_KEYBINDINGS` declares space / shift-left / shift-right; registration + scrub transport belong to the tick-choreography owner.
   Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 (verify-all green, honesty-lint clean; bus/gateway claims via live-wire harness); verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output. UF proof: `tests/e2e/accessibility-contract.spec.ts` — real Chromium with `prefers-reduced-motion` emulated both ways, asserting the discrete transition survives at exactly the contract's snap and the face still inverts, and that the unreduced path runs longer.

tasks.title: Base tool-scripting substrate: single-script tool execution for all pi agents (JSON→TS default)
tasks.body:
1. **T50.01 — Base tool-scripting substrate: single-script tool execution for all pi agents (JSON→TS default)**

   Brief: Give every pi agent the code-mode path — compose a multi-tool task as one TypeScript program executed once, instead of N sequential JSON tool calls. Pi (`@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`) already ships the execution substrate (`core/bash-executor.js` + `read/write/edit/ripgrep/glob`); this tranche wires an orchestration-program run mode where the program's function calls resolve to the agent's entitled tool set. JSON tool-mode stays as the substrate and fallback; the script path becomes the default for any task using ≥2 tools. The security boundary is unchanged — the `--tools` allow-list at spawn plus `isEntitled()` at dispatch — no new VM.
   Build: new script-run capability in `Body/S/S4/pi-agent/lib/` + `Body/S/S4/pi-agent/extensions/`, consuming pi's bash/exec surface; tool-function resolution restricted to `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/shared/entitlement.ts` `isEntitled()`; token accounting on the run.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3.
   Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 — spawn a pi agent on a multi-tool task, assert it emits and runs ONE script whose tool calls resolve through the entitlement allow-list, and record the token delta vs the equivalent staircase. verify-all green, honesty-lint clean; verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: VAK orchestration language: the six C′ coordinates as the typed scripting surface
tasks.body:
3. **T50.03 — VAK orchestration language: the six C′ coordinates as the typed scripting surface**

   Brief: Expose the FULL VAK reflective coordinate system — CPF/CT/CP/CF/CFP/CS — as the typed TS vocabulary Anima writes orchestration scripts against, reusing the already-typed `VakAddress` carried across C (`Body/S/S0/epi-lib/include/vak.h`), Rust (`Body/S/S0/portal-core/src/vak_address.rs`), and the TS spine. This is not the CFP dispatch tools alone (that is one coordinate). Each coordinate is a composable axis of the script: CPF plans it and sets human-review polarity (`Dialogical (00/00)` vs `Mechanistic (4.0/1-4.4/5)`); CF binds the agent/mode (`AGENT_CF`, `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/modules/dispatch-validate.ts`); CFP shapes the execution flow (parallel/chain/fusion/nested/Z); CT carries the Hen artifact templates; CP places the step; CS sequences it (Day/Night′). Every emission carries the full `VakAddress` envelope (the existing emission lint at `cargo test -p epi-s2-graph-services --test vak_envelope_required_on_emissions`).
   Build: new `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/lib/vak-orchestration-surface.ts` (the typed six-coordinate function library); a TS mirror of `Body/S/S0/portal-core/src/vak_address.rs` kept parity-checked; wire the existing `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/extension/dispatch-tools.ts` + `extension/dispatch.ts` primitives as its callable surface.
   Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 — an Anima script composing across ≥4 of the six coordinates executes; every emission is asserted to carry the full six-field `VakAddress`. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: CP nesting: context-frame recursion (each position a leaf or a nested frame)
tasks.effort: each position a leaf or a nested frame
tasks.body:
4. **T50.04 — CP nesting: context-frame recursion (each position a leaf or a nested frame)**

   Brief: CP is the composability engine. A position within a context frame is EITHER a terminal dispatch (leaf) OR expands into a full nested context frame. Example: in `0/1/2`, position `0` can expand to `(00/00)`, position `1` to `(0/1)` or `1/0`; a parent like `(4.0/1-4.4/5)` can nest a full frame at each internal position. This is the `.`-nesting operator surfaced through CP, and it is what lets the language scale. In TS it is plain recursion — a frame is a function, each position resolves to a `dispatch(…)` leaf or a call into another frame — so no new abstraction is required. `CfPosition` (`Body/S/S0/portal-core/src/vak_address.rs`) already carries the frame identities (`Outer4Parent` = `(4.0/1-4.4/5)`, etc.).
   Build: a nesting evaluator in `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/lib/vak-orchestration-surface.ts`; CP-address resolution so a nested frame spawns the correct child pi at each leaf; trace records the nesting depth.
   Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 — a ≥2-deep nested orchestration executes correctly, spawning the right child pi's at each leaf, and the captured trace reflects the nesting structure. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: Anima top-level ownership: the script holds the run; children are the teams/chains
tasks.body:
5. **T50.05 — Anima top-level ownership: the script holds the run; children are the teams/chains**

   Brief: Anima owns and holds the top-level orchestration script and its context — this is Anima's role: managing sub-process runs. The script instantiates child pi's because agent teams/chains/modes ARE subagents; nothing else is agentic. Context isolation: only the variables a downstream child needs are passed from an upstream result, never the full conversation history — the code environment moves data between agents, which is the second half of the token win.
   Build: the executor (`Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/lib/child-pi-executor.ts`) holds run state in Anima; `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/extension/mod.ts` owns the top-level script lifecycle; result→next-input passing extracts only declared variables.
   Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 — Anima runs a multi-agent script; children spawn per dispatch; the parent holds run state across them; a child's input is asserted to be the extracted variables only, not the parent transcript. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: `(00/00)` origination → score lifecycle: dialogue develops the script; a repeatable run becomes a score

7. **T50.07 — `(00/00)` origination → score lifecycle: dialogue develops the script; a repeatable run becomes a score**

   Brief: Every Anima session starts in `(00/00)` — user as source, dialogical — and that dialogue is where the agent develops the orchestration script (as opposed to running a ready-made flow). A task gets a specific expression in the language; one execution is a bounded song; a repeatable expression is persisted as a **score** (a reusable orchestration program); ELO/ML refine scores across runs. Persist scores as first-class artifacts and make a persisted score re-runnable without re-originating.
   Build: score persistence (a `scores/` store written via `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-1p-hen` or `state/`); origination state in `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/extension/dispatch.ts` `CSState` (default `(00/00)`); a re-run entry that loads a score and executes it deterministically.
   Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 — a `(00/00)`-originated dialogue yields a runnable script; it persists as a score; re-running the score reproduces the run. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

9. **T50.09 — CPF review-gate composition: agent-decided human-in-loop checkpoints**

   Brief: The agent decides review gates — the whole review/scoring apparatus exists to judge whether runs were done well. A `(00/00)` human checkpoint is inserted when it is implied by the task, explicitly requested during origination, or learned after the fact as genuinely useful (a review outcome that says "this class of run wanted a checkpoint" becomes part of future scores). tasks.title: Gateway method + contract: register the orchestration-run surface (METHOD_NAMES + capability-matrix + S4-SPEC)
tasks.body:
10. **T50.10 — Gateway method + contract: register the orchestration-run surface (METHOD_NAMES + capability-matrix + S4-SPEC)**

    Brief: Add the gateway method for script orchestration as a first-class contract surface (Architect-authorized). It must be a real member of the canonical protocol, never a side-door — otherwise the no-tool-bypass and capability-parity gates fail by design.
    The registered surface is **`s4'.orchestration.score`** (Architect ruling, 2026-07-27): a READER of the persisted score and the runs recorded against it, not an executor. Pi→subagent is the only agentic path, so a gateway that ran orchestrations would be a second one, and run state belongs to the parent Anima session that holds it rather than to a stateless RPC. The existing `s4'.orchestrate` is a CF→agent capability lookup that executes nothing and is left alone.
    Build: add the method to `Body/S/S3/gateway-contract/src/protocol.rs` `METHOD_NAMES` and its `GatewayProtocolContract` handler in `Body/S/S3/gateway/src/dispatch.rs`; register the capability in `Body/S/S4/plugins/pleroma/capability-matrix.json`; name the surface in `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/S/S4/S4-SPEC.md` (and the anima seam `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/S/S4/S4'/S4-4'-SPEC.md`). Keep the capability-parity assertion (`Body/S/S4/pi-agent/lib/capability-parity.ts`) green.
    Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 — the new method dispatches over a spawned `epi gate start`, strict-Zod parses, capability-parity assertion passes, no-tool-bypass test passes. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: `s4'.context.assemble`: make context-pack assembly a real surface, and make the spine injection visible
tasks.body:
1. **T51.1 — `s4'.context.assemble`: make context-pack assembly a real surface, and make the spine injection visible**

   Brief: `s4'.context.assemble` is named as an implementation hook in `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/S/S4/S4'/S4-4'-SPEC.md` ("API / Envelope / Implementation Hooks") and listed in that same file's `Open Gaps` — "`s4'.context.assemble`, richer `s4'.goal.*`, and persisted Psyche goal state remain open" — and again in `S4-4-SPEC.md` ("`nous_disclose` still uses a helper path for context; target `s4'.context.assemble` must route through explicit S1/S2/S3/S5 contracts"). Nothing in the cycle-3 plan mentions it. The concrete consequence landed during Track 50: `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/composite-entry.ts` assembles the six ta-onta carriers' spine contributions into a system-prompt injection on every session, and **nothing anywhere can see what it injects** — not the user, not the agent, not a test. It was in fact returning that injection from a `session_start` handler, which pi types with no result, so it was silently discarded entirely until 2026-07-25; a surface that had been dead for an unknown period, with no way to notice. That is precisely the class of silent behaviour the whole architecture exists to make visible.
   Build: implement `s4'.context.assemble` as a first-class gateway method (`Body/S/S3/gateway-contract/src/protocol.rs` `METHOD_NAMES` + handler in `Body/S/S3/gateway/src/dispatch.rs`), returning the assembled context pack with per-carrier provenance: which carrier contributed each block, its byte size, and its freshness. Route `composite-entry.ts`'s assembly through it so the injected pack and the reported pack are the same object, not two code paths that can diverge. Register the capability in `Body/S/S4/plugins/pleroma/capability-matrix.json` and keep `Body/S/S4/pi-agent/lib/capability-parity.ts` green.
   Then surface it: a context-pack view in the M5-4′ Agentic Control Room (`Body/M/pratibimba-app`) rendering the live pack per-carrier. The gateway method makes the injection visible to the AGENT; the ACR view makes it visible to the USER, and the surface exists to serve both. This tranche therefore spans S4′ and M5-4′ — which is ordinary, not a scope problem.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3.
   Verify: real behavioral/live-wire proof per Track 00 — dispatch the new method over a spawned `epi gate start`, strict-Zod parse, and assert the returned pack is byte-identical to what a live session actually injects (not a re-assembly); capability-parity and no-tool-bypass pass; plus a UF e2e opening the ACR view and asserting it renders the same per-carrier pack the method returns. verify-all green, honesty-lint clean; verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

2. **T51.2 — M5-3′ Frontend Studio: the one studio of the sixfold with no tranche**

   Brief: `Idea/Bimba/Seeds/M/M5'/M5'-SPEC.md` "Sixfold IDE Surface" names six M5′ studios. Five are covered somewhere in the plan — M5-0′ Library, M5-1′ Canon Studio, M5-2′ Backend Studio, M5-4′ Agentic Control Room (Track 26), M5-5′ Logos Atelier (26.T26.3). **M5-3′ Frontend Studio appears in no track** except a passing mention in Track 38's `omniTuning` fold. Per the spec it "Shapes one Theia shell whose 0/1 daily layout, deep IDE layout, M-extensions, and integrated plugins are one thing" — i.e. the surface through which the app's own layout, extension set, and plugin composition are inspectable and editable. Retarget note: the spec's Theia framing is CONTRACT (what the surface must expose); the Theia plumbing is dead — build it carrier-native in pratibimba-app.
   Build: an M5-3′ Frontend Studio pane in `Body/M/pratibimba-app/src/panes/` exposing the live layout/extension/plugin composition as data (not a screenshot of it): which panes are registered, which composition slots are filled and by what, which integrated plugins are active. It must read the real registries the app boots from, so it cannot drift from what actually rendered.
   **Ordering (Architect ruling 2026-07-25):** this studio reports on the layout system, so it must report on the REAL one. It is gated behind the 4+2 layout layer; building it first would freeze an inventory of a layer that is about to change shape. Note also that there is no data-driven pane registry today — the pane "registry" is the hand-written `switch` in `App.tsx:302` — so "reads the real registries" requires introducing one, which is the only reading that satisfies "cannot drift from what actually rendered".
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3, and requires Track 52 Tranches 5 and 6.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — a UF e2e (`tests/e2e/`) opens the studio and asserts the rendered inventory matches the app's actual registered panes and composition slots, including after a slot is added. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

## Provenance of this track

Gap list established 2026-07-25 by mechanical check: every surface named in the `User-Facing Surface` / `Sixfold IDE Surface` section of `M0'-SPEC.md` … `M5'-SPEC.md`, and every `Open Gaps` entry in the `S4'` shard specs, was grepped (name plus variants) against all 50 existing track files in this plan folder. Surfaces that matched — Library, Canon Studio, Backend Studio, Agentic Control Room, Logos Atelier, Cymatic, and the rest of the M0′–M4′ inventories — are already carried by tracks 21–26, 29, 38 and are NOT duplicated here.

This track does not claim the audit is exhaustive for every sub-clause of every spec; it claims these six are specced, unplanned, and now scheduled. Track 43 (end-of-cycle-3 audit protocol) remains the place to run the full sweep.

tasks.title: One layout-id authority
tasks.body:
1. **T1 — One layout-id authority.**

   Brief: the union is declared four times and inlined three more, with no canonical export. This is not tidiness: T4 and T5 add a real deep layout, and a builder who edits four of seven sites ships a layout that half the app does not believe in.
   Build: one exported `LayoutId` type + `parseLayoutId` guard + `LAYOUT_IDS` tuple in a single module (`src/ui/layoutId.ts` is the natural home — `shellSlotPolicy.ts` and `layoutClaims.ts` already live there). Re-export or import it at all seven sites so `OmniPanelLayoutId`, `ActiveLayoutId`, `LeftSidebarLayoutId`, `CrossLayoutId` become aliases of the one type, and replace the three inline literal unions. Keep `OMNIPANEL_ACTIVE_LAYOUT_PREFERENCE_KEY` and the `'daily-0-1'` fallback behaviour byte-identical — this tranche changes no behaviour.
   Add a guard test that FAILS when a new inline `'daily-0-1' | 'ide-deep'` literal union appears outside the authority module (AST walk, not a regex over prose — the house pattern is `src/chromeContract.test.ts`).
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` green, the new guard test proven to fail on an injected duplicate union and pass when removed, and `pnpm test:e2e` green (no render change is the assertion). verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: Un-conflate face from layout (DCC-07 repair)
tasks.body:
2. **T2 — Un-conflate face from layout (DCC-07 repair).**

   Brief: `resolveM1SurfaceContext` (`m1SurfaceDispatch.tsx:97-112`) hardcodes face 1 ⇒ `layoutId: 'ide-deep'` and face 0 ⇒ `'daily-0-1'`. Face (cosmic/personal) and layout (daily/deep) are orthogonal axes — `App.tsx:153` and `App.tsx:517` treat them as such — and DCC-07 (`M5'-SPEC.md:107`, `:161`) holds shell-1 and full-4+2-depth as distinct authority classes. The current code makes "the user is on the personal face" mean "the user is in the 4+2 depth layout", which is false today and will be actively wrong once T4 lands.
   Build: `resolveM1SurfaceContext` takes the shell's real `activeLayout` and stops deriving it from face. `M1_SURFACE_MODES`' `'standalone-ide-deep'` member is re-derived from (face, layout) rather than face alone — decide and record whether the standalone mode is layout-gated, face-gated, or both, and write that as a decision record in the DR register rather than leaving it implied by a conditional.
   Audit the same conflation elsewhere before assuming this is the only site.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3 and Track 52 Tranche 1.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — unit tests over `resolveM1SurfaceContext` covering all four (face, layout) combinations, plus a UF e2e asserting the M1 surface renders its correct mode on face 1 in the DAILY layout (the case the current code gets wrong). verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

Every transition must produce a `createCrossLayoutIdentityReceipt` (`crossLayoutIdentity.ts:69`) — the switch is the exact place the seven-field invariant earns its keep. `LAYOUT_VERSION` (`App.tsx:271`) bump law applies if default models change.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3 and Track 52 Tranche 2.

tasks.title: `ideDeepDefault()`: the deep layout becomes a real pane set
tasks.body:
4. **T4 — `ideDeepDefault()`: the deep layout becomes a real pane set.**

   Brief: `M5'-SPEC.md:91` specifies the deep IDE layout as "M0/M5 IDE chrome, six M-extensions, two integrated plugins, agentic control room". Today `ide-deep` only SUBTRACTS three daily widgets from face 0 (`App.tsx:1270`). This tranche makes the deep layout a layout.
   Build: a third FlexLayout model `ideDeepDefault()` alongside `personalDefault`/`cosmicDefault`, carrying the deep IDE chrome the spec names. Decide explicitly — and record — whether the deep layout is per-face (a deep model for each face) or face-independent; the spec's "one shell" language and the orthogonality of the two axes both bear on this, and the answer changes `factory(node, activeLayout)`'s shape. The left slot must differ per layout for the first time (`shellSlotPolicy.ts:73` already declares `bottom` as the only per-layout slot — reconcile that declaration with what this tranche actually makes per-layout, and update it rather than leaving it stale).
   Every surface the deep model mounts needs its `CHROME-CONTRACT.md` §2 row in the same change — a `pending` surface id found in the factory FAILS the validator (`CHROME-CONTRACT.md:82`), and `src/chromeContract.test.ts` AST-walks the factory in both directions.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3 and Track 52 Tranche 3.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — a UF e2e enters the deep layout through T3's real switch and asserts the deep pane set renders (not merely that three daily widgets vanished), that the chrome-contract validator agrees with what mounted, and that returning to daily restores the daily pane set with cross-layout identity intact. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: The M0′–M5′ subsystem pages: the 4+2 body
tasks.body:
5. **T5 — The M0′–M5′ subsystem pages: the 4+2 body.**

   Brief: this is the tranche the whole track exists for. `M'-SYSTEM-SPEC.md:168` — "Subsystem pages M0-M5 are the 4+2 explicate development of the (0/1) — the six positions of the matheme made into full-depth workspaces. They are not 'below' the shells and not duplicates of the shells." `M'-SYSTEM-SPEC.md:130` — "The subsystem pages M0'-M5' are the 4+2 body where depth lives. The OmniPanel is where agent, config, readiness, and operator concerns cross-cut everything." `M'-PORTAL-SPEC.md:57` — "The 4+2 layer is where M0' through M5' become fully engageable as their own instruments." `M'-PORTAL-SPEC.md:159` already enumerates `origin_surface` as one of `shell-0`, `shell-1`, `/`, or `4+2`, so the envelope vocabulary for this layer exists before the layer does.
   Build: six subsystem workspaces, one per M0′–M5′, reachable within the deep layout, each gathering that subsystem's depth surfaces as a workspace rather than as sibling tabs in a flat tabset. Plus the Home affordance canon describes: the 0/1 split view by default, with a toggle to the subsystems grid. `M'-TAURI-PORT-SPEC.md:65`'s "do not merge them" is the acceptance posture — a subsystem page that is just the shell's preview widget enlarged has not delivered depth.
   The ~24 depth tabs currently scattered across `cosmicDefault` and `personalDefault` are the raw material; decide per surface whether it moves, is mirrored, or stays a shell preview, and record that disposition the way `dailySurfaceOwnership.ts` records its own (that module's coordinate header is already `M' M5-3'` — it is the existing precedent for exactly this bookkeeping).
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3 and Track 52 Tranche 4.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — a UF e2e reaches each of the six subsystem pages from Home, asserts each renders its own subsystem's depth surfaces (not the shell preview), and asserts cross-layout identity survives entry and exit. The disposition record must account for every one of the currently-scattered depth tabs — an unaccounted tab is a FAIL, not an omission. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: Wire the activity-bar mode registry and reconcile its contradictions
tasks.body:
6. **T6 — Wire the activity-bar mode registry and reconcile its contradictions.**

   Brief: `LEFT_SIDEBAR_MODES` (`leftSidebarModes.ts:66`) declares five modes with per-layout availability, and `resolveModeForLayout` (`:135`) already implements the honest fallback for a mode that cannot survive into daily. None of it runs: `registerLeftSidebarModeCommands` (`:192`) has zero production callers and the rendered sidebar is hardcoded FlexLayout JSON (`App.tsx:180`). Two declared contradictions sit inside this: `smart-connections` declares `availableInLayouts: ['ide-deep']` while `CHROME-CONTRACT.md` lists `semanticConnections` as a live face-1 left-border tab reachable in daily; and the one `ACTIVE_LAYOUT_CLAIMS` row (`layoutClaims.ts:43`) is `code-pending` with a null receiver.

Resolve the `smart-connections` contradiction in whichever direction is correct and update the losing declaration in the same change. Register the mode commands in `COMMAND_CATALOG`. `shellSlotPolicy.ts:23` names `left` as `activity-bar-switched` — this tranche is what makes that policy true.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3 and Track 52 Tranche 4.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — a UF e2e asserts the deep layout offers the deep-only modes and the daily layout does not, that switching layouts while on a deep-only mode falls back per `resolveModeForLayout` rather than rendering an empty slot, and that `activityBarMode` (a cross-layout identity field) is handled coherently by that fallback. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

---

## Provenance of this track

Written 2026-07-25 from a source-level audit of `Body/M/pratibimba-app/src` against `M5'-SPEC.md`, `M'-SYSTEM-SPEC.md`, `M'-PORTAL-SPEC.md`, `M'-TAURI-PORT-SPEC.md` and the M1-4 QL reading of 4+2. Every divergence above carries its `file:line`; none is inferred from a coordinate's name.

The audit was triggered while closing the first tranche of the specced-surface gap-closure track: three of its remaining surfaces are canon-named as deep/4+2 surfaces, and there was no deep layer to land them in. The Architect ruled the layer gets built first.

This track claims the six divergences above are real and now scheduled. It does NOT claim the layout audit is exhaustive — `resolveM1SurfaceContext` was found by grepping for face/layout conflation, and T2 explicitly requires auditing for further sites before assuming it is the only one.

tasks.title: The method-handler port at S-root, and the inversion that makes residency possible
tasks.body:
1. **T53.01 — The method-handler port at S-root, and the inversion that makes residency possible**

   Brief: A gateway that serves `s1'.*`, `s2.*`, `s3'.*`, `s4'.*`, `s5'.*` must reach every layer, and the boundary rule forbids any layer from reaching upward. The only structure that satisfies both is dependency inversion against a port that sits *below* everyone. `Body/S/epi-kernel-contract` is already ratified as the S-stack root contract crate ("parent of all S layers, not an S0 sibling", DR-S0-1) and is the correct home. This tranche defines the port only; no handler moves yet.
   Build: in `Body/S/epi-kernel-contract/src/`, a `method_handler` module declaring the `MethodHandler` trait (method name → params → result/error), the `MethodRegistry` (name → handler, refusing duplicate registration by name), and the shared request/response/error envelope types the handlers exchange. It depends on nothing above S-root. Registration is by explicit call, never by inventory scan, so a handler that is not wired is absent rather than silently defaulted.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — `cargo test --manifest-path Body/S/epi-kernel-contract/Cargo.toml` green, including a duplicate-registration refusal and a dispatch-by-name round trip over two fake handlers; `node Body/M/epi-theia/extensions/scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs` still green. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: Split `epi-logos` into a composition-root binary and a clean S0 library
tasks.body:
2. **T53.02 — Split `epi-logos` into a composition-root binary and a clean S0 library**

   Brief: **Re-scoped 2026-07-28 by Architect ruling — this is no longer a crate split, it is the licence plus the ratchet, and it runs early because everything after it ratchets against it.** The original tranche assumed the S0 *library* carried the upward edges and that splitting `[lib]` from `[[bin]]` would clean it. Measurement said otherwise: a library closed under reference pulls 20 of 28 modules / 69,478 LOC into the binary, leaving a 4,681-LOC rump; no crate consumes `epi_logos` (its consumers are the package's own 166 integration tests, which cannot import a bin-only crate); and the edges the split was meant to remove are the CLI legitimately reaching the modules it exists to expose. The split would have manufactured a crate boundary nothing consumes in order to satisfy a criterion that was measuring the wrong thing.
   Build: (a) split the `S0` row of `rustSStackBoundary` into `S0` (`epi-lib`, `portal-core`, `gemini-embedding`, `epi-s0-settings` — strictly bound, nothing above them) and `S0-membrane` (`epi-logos` — empty `forbiddenImports`, licensed because passthrough access to every module *is* its function), and repoint the `epi-logos` entry in `boundary.crates` at the new row. (b) Delete the 11 `epi-cli` allowlist entries, which the licence supersedes; keep the two `graph-services`→S3 entries, which are genuine violations. (c) Land the magnitude ratchet: `contracts/s0-membrane-residency.json` records the count of files under `src/gate/` + `src/graph/` naming an S1/S2/S3/S5 crate, and `lint-boundaries` fails when it rises. This is the check the boolean permit could not perform. (d) Delete the `pub use epi_s5_*::*` re-export blocks from `src/lib.rs` — consumers import from the owning crate.
   Depends on `53.T53.01`.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — `node Body/M/epi-theia/extensions/scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs` green with the allowlist at 2 and the ratchet reporting its ceiling; the ratchet proven in both directions against the real tree (inject one law-bearing file under `src/gate/` → exit 1 naming the file; remove it → exit 0); `cargo check --manifest-path Body/S/S0/epi-cli/Cargo.toml --lib --bins` green after the re-export deletion.
   *Do not write bare `cargo build` / `cargo test` here.* `verify-tranche` runs Verify-line commands from the repo root, where they resolve to the root workspace and pass without ever compiling `epi-cli` — a green that proves nothing. Always name `--manifest-path`.
   *Baseline, measured 2026-07-28:* the `epi-cli` suite is **already red on main** — 910 passed / 32 failed at HEAD with this tranche's work stashed out, 911/31 with it applied (this tranche fixes one and breaks none). `verify-all --only epi-cli` is therefore RED independent of Track 53. That pre-existing red is not this tranche's to clear and must not hold it hostage; the honest criterion is **no regression against the recorded 32**. Whoever repairs that suite should update this number. Two known components: `s0_does_not_introduce_new_downstream_service_law` fails on 6 unannotated modules, and `agent_extensions_ta_onta` fails 2 vendor-fidelity assertions.
   verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: S3 takes its own control plane: protocol, routing, session, subscription
tasks.body:
3. **T53.03 — S3 takes its own control plane: protocol, routing, session, subscription**

   Brief: `epi-cli/src/gate/server/{dispatch,subscription,websocket,mod}.rs` plus `session_store.rs` and `verifier.rs` are the gateway control plane — S3's by name and by canon. `dispatch.rs` alone is 2,019 lines and already borrows `epi_s3_gateway::dispatch::{classify_method, dispatch_plan_entry}` and `transcripts::append_orchestration_trace`, which is the seam this tranche completes. After it, S3 owns routing end to end and resolves handlers through the T53.1 registry, importing no implementation.

11. **T53.11 — The structural guard that replaces vigilance**

    Brief: Documents do not enforce. After the move, nothing but a test stops the next agent from adding `gate/handlers_for_something.rs` to epi-cli, because that is still the shortest path from a task to a working method. This tranche makes the shortest path the correct one and the wrong one fail loudly. *Amended 2026-07-28:* the magnitude half of this guard already exists — `53.T53.02` landed the residency ratchet, which has been failing on any *increase* since the drain began. What this tranche does is drive `lawBearingFileCeiling` to **0** and replace the count with the structural assertion, so the rule stops being "no more than before" and becomes "none at all". Do not treat the ratchet as this tranche's deliverable already met: a ceiling of 59 and a ceiling of 0 are different laws.

Prove it RED on an injected handler and GREEN on removal, per the house pattern (`src/ui/layoutId.test.ts`).

tasks.title: Decode the transaction log into a typed command stream
tasks.body:
1. **T54.01 — Decode the transaction log into a typed command stream**

   Brief: The log is Neo4j **5.26.21**, `record-aligned` format, log header version 9. Entries are `[version byte][type byte][payload]` with types `TX_START`, `COMMAND`, `TX_COMMIT`, `CHUNK_START`/`CHUNK_END`. Commands carry **both before- and after-images**, which is the entire basis of recovery: the mass-delete transaction's commands contain the full before-image of every destroyed node, property and relationship.
   Build: a decoder (Rust, in a dev-only crate or `Body/S/S2/graph-services` behind a feature) that walks `neostore.transaction.db.0` and emits a typed stream of `NodeCommand` / `PropertyCommand` / `RelationshipCommand` / `RelationshipGroupCommand` / token commands, each with its transaction id and both record images. Resolve numeric ids through the surviving token stores. Decode inline short-string and packed-array encodings, and follow `DynamicRecord` chains for long values.
   Depends on Track 00 Tranche 3.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — the decoder reports a transaction count and a per-command-type census over the real 118 MB log; a round-trip test asserts a known destroyed value is decoded verbatim (`M2-3.q_2b_ethical_interiorisation` must contain both "Picatrix" and "Ficino"); the last `TX_COMMIT` is identified and any incomplete trailing transaction is refused rather than half-applied. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.
   Verify: `cargo test --offline --manifest-path Body/S/S2/graph-services/Cargo.toml --features txlog-forensics` (unit tests plus the golden suites: array decoding and inline node-label unpacking, both asserted against fixtures produced by Neo4j's own decoders) and `cargo test --offline --manifest-path Body/S/S2/graph-services/Cargo.toml --features txlog-forensics --test txlog_forensics_real_log -- --ignored --test-threads=1`. The second needs the forensic archive extracted to `~/bimba-forensic/work` (`tar xzf ~/bimba-forensic/neo4j-data-forensic-20260728.tar.gz -C ~/bimba-forensic/work ./transactions/neo4j/neostore.transaction.db.0`); it is `--ignored` because the 60 MB archive is evidence and is deliberately not in the repo. Always name the single `--test` target, as above. Never satisfy this by sweeping a whole crate's ignored tests — an unscoped ignored-test sweep is the command shape that caused this incident, and `verify-tranche` executes every backticked command-shaped fragment on a Verify line, so such a fragment must never be written here even as a warning.

tasks.title: Reconstruct the pre-wipe graph state and emit reviewable Cypher
tasks.body:
2. **T54.02 — Reconstruct the pre-wipe graph state and emit reviewable Cypher**

   Brief: Replay the decoded stream forward from the log's start, maintaining in-memory nodes, properties and relationships, and **stop at the transaction immediately before the mass delete**. Identify that transaction by its size (~2,800 `:Bimba` node deletions in one tx) and confirm it by checking the next transaction is the seeder's 102 `MERGE`s. That state is the graph as it stood at 19:42 BST on 2026-07-28.
   Build: `recovered-bimba.cypher` — `MERGE` on `coordinate` for nodes, `SET` for properties, typed `MERGE` for relationships, plus a JSON audit carrying each value's originating transaction id. Emit a diff against the CURRENT live graph so the reviewable artifact is the *delta*, not a full dump nobody can read.
   Depends on `54.T54.01`.
   **SCOPE CORRECTION (2026-07-29).** Structure was never lost: the base restore brought back 1,978 `:Bimba` nodes and 12,208 relationships, and 996/996 Map coordinates. What the restore could not bring back is any property with no repo-side source — the dataset replay only restores the generator's `registeredTargets` allowlist, so a `q_*` register curated straight into the graph had nowhere to come from. This tranche therefore recovers **properties**, and emits an additive delta; it does not MERGE nodes or relationships and does not re-create missing coordinates.
   Verify: `cargo test --offline --manifest-path Body/S/S2/graph-services/Cargo.toml --features txlog-forensics --test txlog_forensics_replay -- --ignored --test-threads=1`.
   Superseded verify line (structure-reconstruction framing, kept for the record): real behavioral proof per Track 00 — reconstructed `:Bimba` count is reported against the ~2,800 expectation and against the 1,912 the base restore produced; **every one of the 996 `Idea/Bimba/Map` coordinates appears** (that check already exists as a shell one-liner in this track's history and must be automated here); the reconstruction is loaded into a THROWAWAY instance and `Idea/Bimba/Map` regeneration is re-run against it, with `git diff` on the Map reported as the fidelity measure. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.

tasks.title: Session-log cross-validation, independent of the log parser
tasks.body:
4. **T54.04 — Session-log cross-validation, independent of the log parser**

   Brief: A second source that does not share the parser's failure modes. bimba-mcp calls are recorded verbatim in Claude and Codex transcripts. Measured surface: **3,091 transcript files**; actual tool invocations are `graph_cypher` ×350 (of which only **1** is a write — the `2026-06-17-position4-frame-coordinate-canon` migration, already in `datasets/migrations/`), `graph_set_property` ×62, `graph_sync` ×4, `graph_upsert_node` ×1. Graph **read-backs** in `tool_result` blocks are the richer seam: each is a point-in-time snapshot of a node's full property map.
   Build: a hardened extractor over both harnesses. Three bugs already cost silent data loss and must not recur — (a) never `json.dumps` a record before unescaping, it re-escapes what you are stripping; (b) never pre-filter on the literal `"coordinate"`, escaped payloads spell it `\"coordinate\"`; (c) the property window must be **bidirectional**, since a serialised node map does not always place `coordinate` first (M2-3's `q_3` sits before its anchor). Existing first-pass scripts are in this session's scratchpad and recovered 855 properties / 74 coordinates / 316 q-registers.
   Depends on `54.T54.01`.
   Scheduling: independent — the point of this tranche is that it does NOT share the log parser's failure modes, so chaining it behind T54.02/T54.03 defeats it. The default per-track sequential chain would do exactly that, so it is declared off here; the authored dependency above is the real one. The build proceeds against transcripts alone; only the closing diff consumes T54.02's reconstruction.
   Verify: real behavioral proof per Track 00 — the extractor's output is diffed against `54.T54.02`'s reconstruction and **every disagreement is enumerated**, not summarised; agreement rate reported per property family. verifier ≠ closer; evidence = fresh command output.
